title: Cowichan Valley and Local Flavors Private Tour
includes: Gourmet Charcuterie lunch ( Vegetarian & Vegan options Available )
Wine tastings, option to incorporate cidery
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Up to 4 guests and 1 folding wheelchair
Must be 19+ years old for alcohol intake.
Vegan/vegetarian lunch requests must be made at least 24 hours prior to departure
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a relaxed day just one hour outside Victoria, in Vancouver Island’s beautiful Cowichan Valley—known as the “Warmland” for its mild climate, rolling hills, and rich farmland.

This 6–7 hour private tour includes visits to 3–4 wineries set among peaceful vineyards, forests, and countryside. Sit back, sip, and savor as you take in the stunning Vancouver Island scenery. Meet passionate, family-run producers and enjoy tastings at a comfortable, unhurried pace.

As you explore the valley, you’ll discover charming communities, scenic country roads, coastal views, and hidden local gems. There may also be an opportunity for a casual stop to sample local cheese or enjoy a stroll along a favorite coastal beach.
A gentle, flavor-filled Vancouver Island experience.

Reserve your day when you’re ready—we’d love to share this special place with you.
